8601.overview:
For years, the Monster Tower has beckoned to you and, today, on your fifteenth birthday, you have come of age. You can finally enter the Tower to discover what has happened to your father. Though beware: the tower changes every time you step foot into it. Do you follow in your father's footsteps, or live a peaceful life in the town of Monsbaiya? It's time to choose.

Discover demon eggs and breed them to create new vicious monsters. Gain fortune and fame to help your family and town grow in prosperity. Journey to the top of the tower with an ever-changing layout of the floors. Search for more powerful monsters inside the tower with your monster familiars.

17453.overview: Abe thought he had saved the Mudokons from the evil Glukkons with the destruction of Rupture Farms. However, a new threat has arisen: the Glukkons who run Soul Storm Brewery have created an addictive drink made from Mudokon bones. To get all of the bones they need, Soul Storm has an army of Mudokon slaves excavating the Mudokon City of Death; when one of the slaves is worked to death, he becomes part of the product. The only person who can put a stop to this is Abe. You will guide Abe as he travels through the brewery and tries to destroy the boilers. Along the way, he must also try to save his people. Luckily, Abe can talk to his people and get them to help defeat the enemies and solve puzzles he faces along the way. Help Abe save the Mudokons in Oddworld Adventures 2.

126746.overview: Oha Suta: Dance Dance Revolution GB blends the millenial superpower of the Dance Dance Revolution series with the popular Japanese kids' show Oha Suta... or Oha Star... the jury's still out on that one. While the track list is limited - only 12 songs in total, with all of those being Oha Suta originals - it also incorporates a collectable card system that utilizes stars you earn by showing us your ultimate dance. I CAN'T STOP CRYING. BUCKETS OF TEARS.

132459.overview:
It's Big-Ears' Birthday! Can you help Noddy collect things for the party? Explore Toyland and take part in 10 exciting adventures! * Find the party invitations, but watch out for playful Bumpy Dog. * Collect the birthday presents that the Goblins have hidden. * Fly in the aeroplane and ride the Toyland train. * Find the party hats that the mischievious Sly and Gobbo have hidden in the Dark Wood.

Just some of the fun you'll have with Noddy!

-  Specifically designed and tested for younger children
-  Encourages recognition of left and right, numbers, colours and objects
-  Different skill levels cater to a range of abilities and ages from 3 upwards

132652.overview:
O'Leary Manager 2000 is a football player-manager game released in 2000 for the Game Boy Color. The player can choose whether they want to focus on the management side of football, play the matches themselves on the game's 2D match engine, or combine the two features for a more in-depth experience. It is endorsed by Irish football manager David O'Leary, who was managing Leeds United A.F.C. at the time of the game's release.

The management side of O'Leary Manager 2000 is very comprehensive when compared to similar Game Boy Color games. The player can choose from 240 fully licensed teams from the top two leagues in England, France, Italy, Spain, Germany and the Netherlands to play as or manage, with each team having 16 players in their squad. There is also the option to promote a number of fictional youth team players. However, most of the youth team players are of low ability, so could only realistically be used for back-up when managing a decent quality team.

166140.overview: Ottifanten: Kommando Störtebeker is an auto-running 2D platformer. Baby Bruno goes on a search after his missing teddy bear Honk, through four worlds of six stages each.

167137.overview:
Phenomedia's Moorhuhn franchise makes its first apperance on a console with this title closely based on the original advertisement game.

The player's goal is to shoot Moorhühner for points within 90 seconds, moving a crosshair along a horizontally-scrolling landscape. After every eight shots, the gun must be reloaded. Birds that are farther away gain more points while shooting down balloons or planes deducts points. The game contains three different landscapes (compared to just one in the original) and also introduces bonus items. These items are carried by some birds and are activated when shot. They include weapons like a machine gun or a gun with a wide spread as well as time bonuses.

The game can be played for high score (a high score table is available) and in a tournament mode, which challenges the player with a higher score to reach in each subsequent stage.

171159.overview: The production masterpiece theater series has appeared in GB, the first is "Rascal the Raccoon". The purpose of the player is to live with Rascal on behalf of the main character and return to the forest a year later. As he gets better at communicating with Rascal, Rascal becomes more and more disciplined. Besides discipline, I also learn various tricks. There are two mini-games, and the points obtained there become items for food and communication. In house making, you can freely choose the remodeling of Rascal's room and the bed.

176511.overview: It is about 16 times larger than the previous work and has a rich content. You can play against the computer by choosing from 1 to 4 levels. Equipped with modes that help Othello improve, such as a function that waits without returning the battle, a repeat function that allows you to check the battle from the beginning to the end, a focus function that tells you the best place, and an edit function that allows you to start from your favorite shape. In addition, there are plenty of contents such as a two-player battle mode, a quiz mode, and a "dan certification adventure mode" where you can receive dan certification from the Japan Othello Federation.

178469.overview: The popular comic "King of Bandits JING", which was serialized in "Comic BomBom" until March 1998 and released up to Volume 7, has appeared as a monster breeding simulation RPG. Train and strengthen the monsters you get in battles and events, and acquire various abilities. The battle is a 3v3 team battle. The purpose of the final game is to get the treasure of Aqua Vitae, but even after clearing it, you can enjoy discovering new events and collecting monsters. More than 200 types of monsters can be collected, and more than 30 characters such as friends will appear. You can also exchange monsters with your friends using the communication cable.

179193.overview: "Oha Suta", which is popular among kids on TV, is now available. A puzzle game in which "Yama-chan & Raymond", who is hosting on TV, becomes the main character, and various gimmicks and robots await the fortress to rescue "Oha Girl" kidnapped by Dr. Oha Mizu. There are 60 stages available. The popular corner "Amidakadapura" familiar from the program is reproduced as it is. Fortune-telling today with three scrolling "Amidakuji".

179194.overview: Turn the fun of the festival into a mini game. If you get a high score in a mini game, you will get a Menko card. Collected Enco Cards can be used to play against friends or exchange Menco. The modes are "Kin-chan's goldfish scooping", "Mike's relaxing quoits", "Sachiyo Usui's yo-yo fishing", "Tommy grandpa's shooting", "Ken's octopus grilling", "Haunted mansion captain's haunted mansion", "Poverty god and twin dog mini" "Golf", "Cold Sai and Ko-chan's fortune-telling", and "Menko card game" are available. Fortune-telling can be printed out with a pocket printer.

179196.overview: A game of the popular NHK educational anime "Ojarumaru". There are 3 modes: "Tabi-dachi niru (single-player mode)", "Tokukun-itashimasu (mini-game mode)", and "Welcome to me (two-player battle mode)". Set in Moonlight Town, the game is played in a sugoroku format, collecting items placed in each square, playing against each other in a mini game, and more when one of them finishes at the pond. The one who collects the points of is the winner.

179197.overview: A game produced by the comedy duo "Yoiko" who is familiar on TV. One day, his son goes on a journey in search of his father who suddenly left behind a note. The stage unfolds from downtown to space to heaven in a ridiculous place. Various incidents occur in the path of his son, and strange characters appear one after another. Fight against the waiting enemies in 30 different sub-games!

197459.overview:
Opossum Country is a very creepy little Game Boy horror game where a pizza delivery man encounters oddball characters and suspicious behaviour as he makes a delivery to a mysterious trailer park.

Created for the SCREAM FM game jam, in Opossum Country you follow the adventure of a pizza delivery man whose curiosity gets the better of him as he discovers a very strange trailer park during one of his deliveries. The trailer park in question is inhabited by an eclectic bunch of oddball residents and seems to be led by an elusive character called Bill. After an unsuccessful attempt at delivering the pizza you’re keen to leave, but there’s a mysterious girl that you’d like to rescue from this nightmarish place first.

Taking around 15 minutes to play through, it’s an excellent little horror game with a very unsettling atmosphere and an intriguing story that contains some great twists. The pixel artwork is particularly impressive, with each of the residents rendered in all their grotesque beauty. It does a great job of allowing you to get to know the personalities of each resident and getting to know them as people, which makes the ending that much more poignant. Highly recommended.

215910.overview:
The knights always appear when evil tries to harm the world, the zodiac knights come to the GameBoy Color in this fan made with love for all the fans.

Relive your childhood imagining what it would have been like to have a title like this in your time.

This project is intended to become a full playable game. 

Relive the history of the Knights of the Zodiac through more than 10 levels that tell the arc of the Black Saints.
Secrets and collectibles.
4 playable characters
PixelArt to illustrate the story
Music based on the Anime.

459091.overview:
What if OutRun came to the Game Boy Color?
The Game Boy never got a version of OutRun back in the 80s. During development of a recent Game Boy game (Hero GP) I wondered if I could fix that and what would it look like? 

The answer to that question is OutRun GB 

OutRun GB is a port of the original Arcade version of Out Run to the Game Boy Color. It's the whole game - all the tracks - all the music - all the wind in your hair !:)

It’s OutRun on a Game Boy \o/

CONTROLS
On a real Game Boy Color or Analogue Pocket:

A - Accelerate
B - Brake?
LEFT and RIGHT - Steer

459139.overview: Get ready for a thrilling mission through enemy barracks in Operation: Firestorm, a  top-down shooting adventure! Dodge enemy fire as you attempt to save your fellow soldiers and destroy the Illuminati Army!
